config.budget: shared alpha/(K+1) (K numerators + denominator); production rule hybrid (tracked pool, K=10 = whole pool)
config.rules: naive Gamma=1; well-specified Gamma=r_true; misspecified Gamma=1.25 for r_true in {2.0,2.5}
config.checkpoints: 40 geometric points 250..50,000 (+ horizons; coarser 50,000..N when N > 50,000, nested)
config.decision_semantics: certify(j>k) INCORRECT if Delta_jk <= delta (tex); actionable pair |Delta|>delta

warmup.model: LogisticRegression(C=1) on per-campaign touch counts, FULL latent warm-up journeys, trained once and frozen
warmup.seed_stream: SeedSequence([SEED,1]) disjoint from monitoring streams SeedSequence([SEED,3,rep]) and population SeedSequence([SEED,2])
